_comment: Tiles on the launch page (index.html). Each tile launches a scenario file from web/scenarios/. Variants are alternative files for the same feature, e.g. study conditions.

tiles.title: Predictive fleet management
tiles.description: A delivery mission with live estimates of when it will finish. Before you add or remove a drone, the panel shows how the finish time and mission cost would change.

tiles.title: Operator lenses
tiles.description: Turn map lenses on and off: position uncertainty, communication range, path prediction, and the explored and hazard overlays.

papers.venue: Putting AI in the Critical Loop (book chapter)

tiles.title: Scan review and triage
tiles.description: Drones scan the area and the images arrive for review. Triage each find as high, medium or low priority, and ground vehicles respond in that order.

papers.venue: Putting AI in the Critical Loop (book chapter)

tiles.title: Drone programmer
tiles.description: Agents run their own programmed policies. With limited communication, the operator sees their last known positions and the targets relayed back to the hub.

papers.venue: Putting AI in the Critical Loop (book chapter)

tiles.title: Adaptive abstraction
tiles.description: A high-workload mission where agents and tasks are drawn as heatmaps instead of individual markers. Drag a cluster of agents onto a cluster of tasks to assign them.
